title: The Envious Man and the Envied
logline: An envious neighbour pushes a good man into a well; down there the man overhears the jinn, cures a princess, rises to be king, and repays the envier with gifts instead of punishment.
moral: Envy harms the one who carries it; goodness and forgiveness lift a person higher than any revenge.
tone: Warm fable with one dark turn (the well), a comic-spooky middle (the gossiping jinn) and a quiet, generous ending. The envier is a comic figure with a false smile, never a monster.

beats.summary: The kind man is loved by the whole lane.
His neighbour envies him and wishes him ruin.
To avoid trouble he leaves town and settles far away.
He opens a house of worship and becomes well known for his advice.
The envier arrives behind a false smile and asks to talk by the old well.
The voices are jinn who know why the princess is ill.
The cure: seven white hairs from a black cat tail.
The hairs are burned, the spirit leaves and the princess recovers.
Son-in-law, vizier, then king of the land he entered as a stranger.
The envier recognises the king and expects punishment.
The raised hand opens: gifts, and he is let go unharmed.

sets.description: Planned village lane (KD-008) arranged as two flat-roofed house fronts sharing a low wall: kind man house x 90..430 (roof line y 520, door x 230..310, top y 720), envier house x 570..910 (roof line y 540, door x 600..670, window x 700..790, y 610..700), wall x 430..570 with its top at y 800, ground y 900. Sky from Library sky / planned dayCycle.
Planned countryRoad strip (KD-013, KD-026), about 2400 units long: road at y 900, far town skyline at the left end, three milestones, a low rise at the right end.

New: a quiet yard with a small domed prayer house and an old well. House walls x 60..440, y 560..900, cream with blue dot shading; dome centre (250, 560) radius 130 in white with a plain ball finial (top y 410); arched double door x 200..300, top y 700, with open and closed states and a light spill polygon. Old well at x 780: round stone rim 150 wide, 70 high (top y 830), two posts and a crossbeam at y 690, rope and bucket, two cracked stones and weeds. Palm (planned palmTree) at x 930. Library sky presets day and dawn, hillTrees, ground at y 900.
Library cutaway well (The Lion and the Hare), used with a day-to-night sky strip and a sand heap at the bottom. Shaft about x 540..815 (approximate, measure on the set).

The same Library wellShaft with a new overlay: a rounded cavern pocket cut into the earth left of the shaft, about x 90..500, y 720..1060, navy interior with a rock, a lamp and a lit disc; the rest of the cutaway darkened to night.

Planned palaceHall (AN-095, KD-017): arched interior, window top-left with a light shaft, tiled floor at y 900, dais and throne on the right (centre x 800, seat y 760, back top y 520), a vizier cushion and lamp stand at x 640, an open door at the left edge x 60..160.

props.description: Planned bindle: bundle on a stick over the shoulder.
One small sandal (30 x 10) left on the well rim at 60.9, found at 101.9, returned at 106.0.
Planned brass lamp with flame 0..1 and a smoke wisp: at the shrine door, in the cavern, and on the palace stand (it goes out for the two deaths).
Planned rope, used over the well crossbeam for the rescue.
Small bowl on three legs, 70 wide x 60 tall, yellow with red dot shading; flame 0..1 and a white smoke curl that follows a bezier to a target point.
The sultan crown as a separate prop (same drawing as on the king preset) so it can rest on the throne seat and be lowered onto a head.
The tall jewelled turban of the vizier preset as a separate prop for the cushion and the hand-over.
Planned purse (AN-095), fat, with two coins showing.
Small chest 80 x 55 with a yellow band, plus a folded robe (a 90 x 24 red slab) for the gift pile.

Planned iconBalloon (KD-026): picture balloons for the wordless jinn talk. Icons needed: dome, kind man head, princess head (well and ill), crown, dark wisp, question mark and tick, bowl, seven hairs, cat with tail.

scenes.summary: Years pass; the sultan dies and the stranger is crowned king of the country he once walked into with a bundle on a stick.

scenes.summary: One day in court the king spots his old neighbour in the crowd. The envier recognises the man he pushed into the well and shakes with fear.

actions.action: court day: a short line of petitioners in the hall, a servant at the door
actions.acting: each petitioner fidgets differently

actions.action: the king eyes move along the line and stop
actions.acting: saccades along four heads, then a hard stop; lid lifts

actions.library: S.arrow; envier variant: grey in the beard, patches

actions.action: leans forward on the throne, brows up
actions.acting: recognition without anger: a slow blink

actions.action: the petitioners feel the king look and step aside one by one, leaving the envier alone in the open

actions.action: slowly looks up: the royal shoes, the robe, the face

scenes.summary: But the raised hand opens: the king orders money and gifts for him and lets him go in peace. THE END.

actions.action: peeks out between his fingers
actions.acting: one eye through the gap, brow -0.6

actions.action: beckons the servant with two fingers
actions.acting: calm, gaze to the servant then back to the envier

actions.action: the servant walks up with a tray
actions.acting: brisk small steps, tray level

actions.action: opens his arm toward the bright open door
actions.acting: kind, no gloating; a nod

actions.action: THE END title in the upper third, held to 173.0

ending.description: After the last word (169.86) the envier has gone out into the daylight with his gifts. The king stands by the throne with the princess, the cat on the throne arm. THE END appears at 170.2 in the upper third and holds to 173.0 with one blink from the king and one flick of the cat tail; a single quiet chime at 170.4.

subtitles.ar: عاش رجلان في حي واحد،|وكان أحدهما محبوبًا بين الناس بسبب أخلاقه الطيبة.|أما جاره فكان يحسده على محبة الناس له،|ويتمنى أن يفقد كل ما يملك.
subtitles.en: Two men lived in one neighborhood.|One was loved for his good character.|His neighbor envied this affection|and wished he would lose everything he had.

subtitles.ar: حاول الرجل الطيب أن يتجنب المشاكل،|لكن حسد جاره لم يتوقف.|وأخيرًا غادر المدينة، واستقر في مكان بعيد.|هناك فتح بيتًا للعبادة، وصار الناس يزورونه ويستمعون إلى نصائحه.
subtitles.en: The kind man tried to avoid trouble,|but his neighbor’s envy did not stop.|Eventually he left town and settled far away,|opening a house of worship where people came for advice.

subtitles.ar: سمع الحاسد أن جاره أصبح مشهورًا،|فذهب إليه متظاهرًا بالصداقة.|طلب منه أن يتحدث معه على انفراد قرب بئر قديمة.|وعندما اقترب الرجل من البئر، دفعه الحاسد إلى داخلها وهرب.
subtitles.en: Hearing that his neighbor had become famous,|the envious man visited pretending friendship.|He asked to speak privately near an old well.|As the man approached it, the envier pushed him inside and fled.

subtitles.ar: لم يمت الرجل في البئر.|وفي الليل سمع أصواتًا غريبة تتحدث تحت الأرض.|كانت أصواتًا لجن يعرفون أن ابنة السلطان مريضة بسبب روح شريرة،|ويعرفون أيضًا كيف يمكن علاجها.
subtitles.en: The man did not die in the well.|At night he heard strange voices beneath the ground.|They belonged to jinn who knew that the sultan’s daughter was ill because of a possessing spirit,|and knew the cure.

subtitles.ar: قال أحد الجن إن العلاج يحتاج إلى سبع شعرات بيضاء من ذيل قط أسود.|حفظ الرجل الكلام جيدًا.|وفي الصباح جاء أصحابه يبحثون عنه،|فسمعوا صوته وأخرجوه من البئر.
subtitles.en: One jinn said the treatment required seven white hairs from the tail of a black cat.|The man remembered the words.|In the morning his followers searched for him,|heard his voice, and pulled him out.

subtitles.ar: وبعد مدة وصل السلطان يسأل عن علاج لابنته.|أخذ الرجل الشعرات من القط وأحرقها|كما سمع في البئر.|خرجت الروح الشريرة من الأميرة، وشفيت أمام عيني أبيها.
subtitles.en: Later the sultan arrived seeking help for his daughter.|The man took the hairs from the cat and burned them|as he had heard in the well.|The spirit left the princess, and she recovered before her father’s eyes.

subtitles.ar: فرح السلطان كثيرًا، وزوج الرجل من ابنته.|ثم مات الوزير، فأصبح الرجل وزيرًا مكانه.|وبعد وفاة السلطان تولى الحكم،|وصار ملكًا على البلاد التي كان قد جاء إليها غريبًا.
subtitles.en: The delighted sultan married his daughter to the man.|When the vizier died, the man became vizier;|after the sultan’s death,|he became king of the country where he had arrived as a stranger.

subtitles.ar: وفي يوم رأى الملك جاره القديم بين الناس.|عرف الحاسد أنه أمام الرجل الذي دفعه إلى البئر، فخاف العقاب.|لكن الملك أمر بإعطائه المال والهدايا،|وتركه يرحل سالمًا.
subtitles.en: One day the king recognized his former neighbor among the people.|The envier realized he faced the man he had pushed into the well and feared punishment.|But the king ordered gifts and money for him|and let him leave safely.

new_assets.name: cat
new_assets.description: Black cat, about 190 wide x 150 tall at s 1, feet at (x, y). Pose fields: ph, amp (walk), sit 0..1, arch 0..1 (back up under a stroking hand), tailUp 0..1, tailCurl, tailHairs (number of white hairs at the tail tip, 0..7), ears -1..1, lick, eyes, plus the shared acting fields. Used in the yard, on the throne arm and as a balloon icon.
new_assets.implementation: Follow the fox file as a model: body ellipse, four tapered legs driven by walk(), round head with two triangle ears, eye2 eyes in yellow, tail as a tapered brush stroke along a 3-point bezier; tail hairs are short white lines fanned at the tip. Register through acting() in registry.js once approved.

new_assets.name: shrineYard
new_assets.description: Domed prayer house, old well and palm in a quiet yard (dimensions in sets). Door open/closed, light spill, well with rim, posts, crossbeam, rope and bucket.
new_assets.implementation: Bake once with bake(): Library sky, hillTrees and ground; house as a rect plus a half ellipse dome with the style brush outline and blue dot shading; door as two rects with an angle key; well rim as a stone-patterned rounded rect with a dark ellipse mouth. Draw the rim front again after any actor who goes into the well so the fall is clipped by it.

new_assets.name: wellCavern
new_assets.description: A cavern overlay for the Library wellShaft: rounded pocket in the earth beside the shaft with a rock, a lamp and a lit disc, opened by an iris.
new_assets.implementation: Draw the baked wellShaft, a navy night wash over the earth, then a clipped blob path (K.noise edge, seeded) filled navy with a yellow halftone disc (planned lampLight). The iris is the blob clip scaled from 0 to 1 about the eyes. No change to the Library wellShaft itself.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (sultan, princess, jinn pair)
new_assets.description: Uses the planned costume layer: king (as sultan, with age), lady/maiden plus crown (as princess, with an ill option), devil (as two small jinn in red and blue palettes without the cape), vizier (age 1), servant, ascetic and villager.
new_assets.implementation: Parameters on the Library person only: headwear, beard, palette, width and height factors, age. If the costume layer is not in Library yet, build it in this story as a wrapper that draws headwear and robe over person() and move it to Library after approval.

new_assets.name: windSpirit (dark palette) as evilSpirit
new_assets.description: The planned windSpirit drawn in navy and black as a possessing spirit: idle coil round a head, coil (alarm), blow (stretch and exit).
new_assets.implementation: Five tapering brush bands along one bezier whose control points orbit the princess head; the exit moves the end points up and out over 0.5 s with a 2-frame white flash.

new_assets.name: brazier
new_assets.description: Three-legged bowl with a flame and a steerable smoke curl.
new_assets.implementation: Half ellipse bowl, three line legs, flame as a teardrop path scaled by flame 0..1, smoke as three white brush strokes along a bezier with alpha by age.

new_assets.name: spiralEyes
new_assets.description: Planned spiral pupils (KD-013) for the possessed princess, with a spin speed that can fall to 0 and blend to normal eyes.
new_assets.implementation: Two Archimedean spirals in place of the pupils, rotation = spin * t; cross-fade to eye2.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon in strip mode for the jinn gossip (three frames) and single mode for the news in S7.
new_assets.implementation: Library cloud or S.box outline with a tail toward the speaker; icons are small flat drawings made from the same cast functions at s 0.3 or simple shapes.

owner_questions: The house of worship is drawn as a small plain domed building with a ball finial and no religious symbol or writing (default); confirm, or ask for a crescent.
The shove is shown, but the fall itself is hidden by the well rim and by the cut; we never see him hit the bottom (default: softened this way).
The jinn are drawn as two small comic horned figures, one red and one blue, more gossipy than frightening (default).
The evil spirit is a dark smoke wisp with a small face and the princess shows spiral eyes; no pain or convulsion is shown (default).
The deaths of the vizier and the sultan are shown only by an empty seat and a lamp going out, never a body (default).
The cat is unharmed and calm while the seven hairs are taken, and returns as the king companion at the end; this small running detail is an addition to the script (default: keep).

Additions beyond the script used as staging: rubbish tipped over the wall as the trouble, a sandal left on the well rim that the followers find, and a flashback inset of him arriving as a stranger (default: keep all three).

Invented English lettering: LOVED BY ALL, ENVY, GRRR, FAR AWAY, PSST!, OLD WELL, SHOVE!, ALIVE!, JINN, 7, DOWN HERE!, LATER..., THE SULTAN, POOF!, CURED!, HA HA!, VIZIER, KING, GULP!, THE END (default: keep these 20, no others).
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template. World 1000 x 1230, ground y 900 on every set except the well cutaway. Set LIFE.t = t each frame so everybody blinks; give explicit lids where listed.

Word cues: use w(p, n) from timing.json; every action above lists its Arabic cue word and time. The words at 141.48 and 141.99 are interpolated: do not hang a sharp accent on them (the crown lift at 141.3 is a slow move).

One person figure for all humans. Keep the kind man face, beard and yellow sash constant through the four costumes; change costume only on cuts (33.98, 129.7) or on screen (turban 137.1, crown 142.5).
Save the shove as a constant (SHOVE = arm angles for both arms) and reuse it unchanged in the S19 thought cloud, as the Thief film did with GRIP.
Mask on / mask off for the envier in S8-S9: the smile is only on while the kind man can see his face.

Wells: shrineYard draws the rim front after the actors; the wellShaft cutaway is the Library set unchanged, the cavern is an overlay. The jinn eyes in S10 and the jinn in S11 must be at the same world positions.
Picture balloons must stay above head height and inside the picture panel; the bottom third holds only the subtitles. Lettering never covers a face.
Shake only inside the panel clip (60.26 and 120.2), 3 frames, small.

Sound: SND master 0.6. Effects only at 3.1 pop, 15.0 pop, 19.0 pop, 24.05 thud, 42.5 chime, 47.45 whoosh, 149.3 chime, 170.4 chime. Everything else is silent picture action because the narration has no other pause of 0.6 s.
Transitions: whips at 9.72 and 30.3, iris at 73.78, dissolve at 98.14, the single LATER... card at 106.36 (covering about 106.2 to 107.9), wipe at 129.7, dissolve at 138.68.
Subtitles: four chunks per paragraph, marked in the subtitles array; copy them to chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt and verify against the script by program.
warnings: Many assets here are planned names from other stories (person costume layer, village, countryRoad, palaceHall, iconBalloon, thoughtCloud, dayCycle, inset circle, flush, spiralEyes, windSpirit, oilLamp, rope, purse, bindle, runInPlace, person kneel/sit). If they are not in Library when this film is built, they must be built here first: the total drawing load is then large (L).
Five sets and thirteen cast entries is a lot for 170 s; the people are all one figure with costumes, which keeps it feasible.
Only eight narration pauses exist, so the shove, the spirit exit and the rescue have no sound effect; they must read from picture alone.
The LATER... card overlaps the first two words of paragraph 6 (106.36 to about 107.9); the sultan entrance is cued at 108.6 so nothing is hidden.
S11 and S12 hold one cutaway for 24 s; the balloons, the two jinn acting and the listening man must keep something changing every 1-2 s.
